transport: Same VE.Direct HEX framing and line settings as victron-mppt-vedirect-hex. The MPPT RS also carries a VE.Can port and a user I/O connector with REMOTE_L / REMOTE_H pins.
blocks: Core VREG map as victron-mppt-vedirect-hex, with documented replacements and additions: DC channel 0xED8B ripple / 0xED8D battery voltage (REPLACES 0xEDD5, and changes type un16 -> sn16) / 0xED8F battery current (REPLACES 0xEDD7, un16 -> sn16) · per-tracker panel data 0xECC3/0xECCB/0xECCC/0xECCD (tracker 1) through 0xECF3/0xECFB/0xECFC/0xECFD (tracker 4) · 0x0244 tracker count · 0xEDB1 panel input resistance, 0xEDB2 panel starting voltage, 0xEDBF panel maximum current · 0xEDC6/0xEDC7 equalise voltage and current maximum · 2-wire BMS 0xD0C0/0xD01F · per-tracker daily history 0x10A0-0x10BE.

The RS has its own battery-type enumeration (1 AGM_NORMAL 57.6 V, 2 AGM_HIGH 58.8 V, 3 LITHIUM 56.8 V, 255 USER) that does not match the 30A-100A rotary-switch table or the 10A-20A table. Three battery-type encodings live in one document.
0xD0C0 remote input mode is only writable while a user-defined battery type (0xEDF1 = 0xFF) is selected.
48 V only. The RS does not do 12 V or 24 V, so it is not a drop-in comparison for the rest of the retail list.
unmappedReports: Per-tracker pv-power / pv-voltage / pv-current (0xECCC etc.) — MetricKind has one pv-power, not one per string. A 4-tracker RS 450/200 has four independent arrays and the contract can only express their sum. This is the sharpest contract gap in the Victron line: shading on one string is invisible., 0x0244 number of MPPT trackers — no MetricKind, and needed before the per-tracker registers mean anything., 0xED8B battery ripple voltage — no MetricKind. It is the standard early-warning signal for a failing cell or a loose DC connection., 0xD01F 2-wire BMS input state (input enabled / allow-to-discharge / allow-to-charge) — no MetricKind., 0x10A0..0x10BE per-tracker daily history: energy, peak power and Voc-max per tracker. No MetricKind., 0x0207 off-reason bit 1 'physical power switch' — RS-only, and no MetricKind for off reason at all.
